White Orchard · Illustrated scenes

These scenes were recreated for Operation Phoenix in the guide’s worn, detailed dark-fantasy aesthetic. They are artistic reconstructions, not literal game screenshots or precise navigation diagrams. Location references are linked below; use the regional map and walkthrough for exact guidance. The Witcher setting and characters belong to their respective owners. This unofficial fan guide is not endorsed by CD PROJEKT RED.
